subject_definitions:
@style_base is the primary visual reference for <Subject 1>, defining the exact Classic Doom 1993 first-person rendering language, the airborne Market Garden battlefield, the paratrooper viewpoint, muted olive-and-brown palette, chunky low-resolution geometry, pixel texture scale, and period military equipment.
<Subject 1> is the same playable first-person Allied paratrooper viewpoint and coherent 1993 DOS-era game world defined by @style_base. Keep the viewpoint, weapon scale, texture density, palette, and interface-free cinematic presentation consistent.

summary:
[reference generation] A continuous first-person descent into a Market Garden village begins in the airborne exterior defined by @style_base and advances toward a damaged stone farmhouse.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain the first-person viewpoint, Classic Doom 1993 rendering language, WWII Market Garden identity, palette, texture scale, weapon-view proportions, and coherent level design defined by @style_base while allowing new camera travel and action.
@style_base: fully_preserved - use its airborne battlefield, paratrooper silhouettes, landscape layout, olive-and-brown colors, and retro pixel-art treatment as the scene's visual identity.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Begin in the same first-person paratrooper viewpoint and Classic Doom 1993 visual language as @style_base. The camera descends beneath a canvas parachute over a war-torn Dutch village at dawn. Other Allied parachutes drift at different depths, anti-aircraft bursts expand into coarse pixel smoke, and fields, canals, tiled roofs, and a church tower grow steadily larger below. Keep all movement physically continuous and preserve the reference's low-resolution texture rhythm rather than smoothing it into modern realism.

The viewpoint swings gently toward a damaged stone farmhouse. Boots strike the muddy ground, the parachute canopy collapses behind the camera, and the same first-person momentum becomes a short sprint between hedgerows. A period weapon rises naturally into the lower frame. The camera reaches a splintered doorway and pushes inside without a cut. End while exterior dawn light remains visible behind and a dark timber corridor is emerging ahead; preserve the forward motion through the boundary.

overall_soundscape:
Wind rush and canvas flutter during descent give way to a heavy landing, muddy footfalls, distant artillery, scattered rifle fire, wood creaks, and a close doorframe scrape. Keep the sound spatial and game-world diegetic.

non_diegetic_music:
Low martial drums and a restrained ominous brass pulse build gradually beneath the descent, remaining secondary to the battlefield ambience.

widgets_values:
REF2V STUDIO SCHEDULED — QUICK START

Copy both bundled PNG files into ComfyUI/input/. @style_base is active in every scene; @interior is active only in scene 2. Keep aliases in the Plan prompt. The Scheduled Ref2VA wrapper compiles them to the native picture numbering for the current scene.

Scene 1: @style_base → <Picture 1>.
Scene 2: @style_base → <Picture 1>, @interior → <Picture 2>.

The Plan uses strict reference compliance, generated audio, 22 motion-context frames, 20-step sampling with res_multistep and the simple scheduler. Plan Studio and Rich Scene Prompt Editor stay synchronized with the Plan. The inline Run Manager archives both connected image-loader assets and can restore their loader selections with a saved run.
